title: Names called twice: Abraham, Jacob, Moses, Samuel
summary: Four Old Testament passages in which God or the LORD calls a person by name twice (Abraham, Jacob, Moses, Samuel); the repeated names are colour-coded, 'angel' is struck through and replaced by 'messenger' in Genesis 22:11, and the three men answer 'Here am I.'

text.text: But the ~~angel~~ messenger of the LORD called to him from heaven and said,
"Abraham, Abraham!" And he said, "Here am I."—Genesis 22:11
God spoke to Israel in visions of the night and said,
"Jacob, Jacob." And he said, "Here am I."—Genesis 46:2
When the LORD saw that he turned aside to look,
God called to him from the midst of the bush and said,
"Moses, Moses!" And he said, "Here am I."—Exodus 3:4
Then the LORD came and stood and called as at other times, "Samuel! Samuel!"
And Samuel said, "Speak, for Your servant is listening."—1 Samuel 3:10
